page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL40S is a GPU-accelerated server virtualized via KVM. It features an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9575F processor with 32 physical cores running at 2.0 GHz, configured with a shared CPU allocation. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing 12.0 GB of RAM per core. Acceleration is delivered by three NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing a total of 144 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage.

In benchmark evaluations, this server demonstrates top-tier performance. Single-core and multi-core CPU capabilities rank in the top 10% via stress-ng and Geekbench testing, supported by advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and AVX_VNNI. Memory bandwidth is strong, with read-only cached small block speeds reaching 6377.89 GB/sec and uncached large block read speeds at 331.99 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET throughput also place in the top 10%, alongside high static web serving throughput.

Given the high density of GPU resources and system memory, this server offers a specialized hardware profile for workloads requiring massive parallel processing without local storage dependencies. The absence of built-in local storage requires external storage integration, which is a key architectural tradeoff. It is highly suitable for GPU-accelerated workloads, large-scale data processing, parallel scientific computing, and memory-intensive database operations.
